shadows.name: card-rest
shadows.purpose: Subtle hover depth for a clearly interactive event surface.

shadows.name: overlay
shadows.purpose: Separate floating menus, pickers, and dialogs from their backdrop.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The main action, with clear contrast and a persistent keyboard focus ring.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { min-height: 44px; padding: 0 16px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 6px; background: var(--color-accent); color: #fff; font: 600 14px/1.4 var(--font-ui); transition: background-color 150ms ease, color 150ms ease; } .ds-button-primary:hover { background: var(--color-accent-hover); } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-focus); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-button-primary:disabled { background: var(--color-disabled-surface); color: var(--color-disabled); cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A quieter action that retains a visible boundary on white surfaces.
components.css: .ds-button-secondary { min-height: 44px; padding: 0 16px; border: 1px solid var(--color-border); border-radius: 6px; background: var(--color-surface); color: var(--color-text); font: 600 14px/1.4 var(--font-ui); transition: background-color 150ms ease, border-color 150ms ease; } .ds-button-secondary:hover { background: var(--color-canvas); } .ds-button-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-focus); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: A legible, labeled working control with an explicit focus treatment.
components.html: <label class="ds-field-label" for="event-title">Event title</label><input id="event-title" class="ds-input" placeholder="Enter a title">
components.css: .ds-field-label { display: block; margin-bottom: 5px; color: var(--color-text); font: 600 13px/1.4 var(--font-ui); } .ds-input { box-sizing: border-box; width: 100%; min-height: 44px; padding: 8px 11px; border: 1px solid var(--color-border); border-radius: 6px; background: var(--color-surface); color: var(--color-text); font: 400 16px/1.5 var(--font-ui); } .ds-input:focus-visible { border-color: var(--color-accent); outline: 2px solid var(--color-focus-ring); outline-offset: 1px; } .ds-input:disabled { background: var(--color-disabled-surface); color: var(--color-disabled); }

components.name: Success Badge
components.description: A compact status with a readable text label and semantic color pairing.
components.css: .ds-status-success { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 24px; padding: 2px 8px; border: 1px solid var(--color-success-border); border-radius: 999px; background: var(--color-success-soft); color: var(--color-success); font: 600 12px/1.4 var(--font-ui); }

components.name: Inline Error
components.description: An announced error that names the state in text and preserves a readable contrast pair.
components.html: Error Please check the highlighted fields.
components.css: .ds-alert-error { padding: 11px 14px; border: 1px solid var(--color-danger-border); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--color-danger-soft); color: var(--color-danger); font: 400 14px/1.5 var(--font-ui); } .ds-alert-error strong { margin-right: 5px; font-weight: 700; }

components.name: Working Surface
components.description: A bounded content surface; use only where grouping improves scanability.
components.css: .ds-surface { padding: 20px; border: 1px solid var(--color-border); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--color-surface); color: var(--color-text); }

narrative.overview:
This is an operating interface for preparing and running events, not a wedding-only design product. Its character comes from editorial hierarchy applied with operational restraint: precise typography, quiet surfaces, reliable state cues, and a single confident accent. The product’s invitations may carry their own event-specific visual styles; the application chrome remains consistent and task-focused.

Use mineral neutrals and jade without literal paper textures, ornamental flourishes, glass effects, or decorative gradients. Figtree carries the working interface. Playfair Display is reserved for editorial/public headings where its contrast adds meaning, not for dense tables or routine controls.
keyCharacteristics: Considered and composed, without slowing down operational tasks.
Border-led structure with modest depth only where interaction needs it.
Status is explicit in text and supported—not replaced—by color.
Shared semantic tokens serve React and Blade without replacing either styling stack.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Jade is the only primary brand accent. Status hues are reserved for status and feedback, not scattered decoration.

rules.name: The Working Type Rule
rules.body: Never use the editorial face for dense data, status labels, or form controls. Invitation content remains governed by the invitation design selected for that event.

rules.name: The Quiet Rest Rule
rules.body: The interface is flat at rest. Elevate only a layer that must read as floating or interactive.

dos: Do use the shared semantic tokens from resources/css/design-tokens.css in both existing CSS pipelines.
Do keep status meaning in the label and use color as reinforcing context.
Do preserve Figtree for operational reading and Playfair Display for selective editorial emphasis.
Do keep the focus indicator visible and honor reduced-motion preferences.
Do use borders and whitespace before reaching for shadows or additional cards.
donts: Don't use a gradient, glass blur, or decorative animation as a substitute for product content.
Don't make every surface a card or every control pill-shaped.
Don't use color alone for RSVP, delivery, check-in, pledge, or import state.
Don't surface pledge balances as payment verification or an admission requirement.
Don't replace event-specific invitation design typography with application chrome styles.
